senses.gloss: m. pl. (enlargement of קרם; cmp. כְּרוּם a. כַּרְכּוֹם I) [green or yellow plants,] ḳarmulin, name of a sort of gourd, the leaves of which are eatable.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 2:7:4">Y. Shebi. II, end, 34ᵇ</cite> <he>ק׳ פטורין וכ׳</he> ḳ. are exempt from tithes, … as long as they have not formed gourds; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 7:1:4">Y. Ned. VII, beg. 40ᵇ</cite>.
<cite ref="Tosefta Shevi'it 4:19">Tosef. Shebi. IV, 19</cite> <cite ref="S01950"><he>קְרוּמְנִין</he></cite> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>קרמלוס</he>, <cite ref="S01950"><he>קְרוּמְלִים</he></cite>).

<cite ref="Tosefta Negaim 1:5">Tosef. Neg. I, 5</cite> (expl. <cite ref="J00667"><he>ירקרק</he></cite>) <he>כשעוה וכקוּרְמָל</he> ed. Zuck. (Var. <he>וכקוּרְמָן</he>; R. S. to <cite ref="Mishnah Negaim 11:4">Neg. XI, 4</cite> <he>וכקורמין</he>) of the color of wax or of ḳ., v. <cite ref="K01233"><he>כַּרְמֶל</he></cite>.
